item.title: Re: The bee movie.
item.content:encoded: I would like to announce that I have reworked my draft in regards to the advice I received. The SCP itself is now part of a bigger story about a father, a son, and a life of regrets which I (HOPEFULLY) intend to explore in further entries.

item.title: Re: The bee movie.
item.content:encoded: That's fair, do think a good hook would be something like, the bee movie effect is actually something that was created by an individual/group a la Serpent's hand/Dado?

item.title: Re: The bee movie.
item.content:encoded:
I think this is a novel idea, but the problem for me is there doesn't really seem to be any pull.

Yes, it's original, but it feels like there's almost nothing going on, and there's nothing to attract. I understand that it is a new idea, and nothing has been done regarding the bee movie I don't think, but that doesn't really seem like it justifies a whole SCP.

If you can come up with a good why(how was it made? what is it's purpose?) and a good hook(is there any reason we should be worried that people think the bee movie exists? Is there anything else to it other than the bee movie not actually existing?), I would be inclined to like it more, but as it stands it doesn't seem all that special to me.

item.title: The bee movie.
item.content:encoded:
SCP ARTICLE. SEEKING GREENLIGHT.
Alright, so here's my idea for an SCP, I have heard the bee movie be described on Tumblr as a 'mass fever dream' and I thought to myself that sounds like an SCP.

ELEVATOR PITCH:So, basically the bee movie (SCP) doesn't actually exist, and instead what people think they were watching is a bizarre memitic in which at some point they are exposed to someone who has also been affected by the bee movie. Or in simpler terms The Bee movie is actually a virus that makes people think they've seen it.

ATTENTION GRABBER: As far as I know I don't think the bee movie has been made an official SCP yet, I know it's been mentioned, but I don't think there's anything concrete yet.

Additional Notes: I don't really have any concerns, but I do want to make sure that this isn't an idea someone else has brought up. If it is I apologize and will promptly think of something else.
